pages.title: Ashes of Sin
pages.text: By sifting through $(l:sin_alignments/arcane_ruins)Suspicious End Stone$(), you can find some potentially useful items! Among these items, are ashes of sin, which are used in the creation of $(l:sin_alignments/herbal_sigils)aligned Herbal Sigils$().
Ashes of sin can also be used make $(l:mystical_campfire_conversion/enigmatic_extract)Enigmatic Extract$() that extracts Vile Ashes.
